item.title: 252 health goals you can act on
item.summary: Browse practical, research-backed guides for outcomes like sleeping better, lowering resting heart rate, building strength, and training for an event.
item.details: Every guide works on its own. Sleep, Life Stages, and Cardio goals are grouped under clear section labels with roomier cards, while Sleep and Life Stages add quick visual cues that carry into each guide. Search understands common phrasing such as iron man; when there is no exact guide, Start with Murph opens Messages with your goal already filled in.
